title: Workplace and Employment Discrimination for Pre-existing Medical History
what_it_is: Workplace and Employment Discrimination for Pre-existing Medical History

sections.label: Fair recruitment and discrimination complaints
sections.summary: MOM acts against discriminatory employers, launched the Tripartite Standard on Recruitment Practices, and examined 2,100 unfair employment complaints with three discrimination cases in four years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Pre-existing medical history should not be a factor if it does not affect the employee's ability to perform the job.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) will take action against employers found to have engaged in discriminatory practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM and tripartite partners have also launched the Tripartite Standard on Recruitment Practices in November last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To date, more than 240 employers with over 245,000 employees have signed up.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These employers have committed to use only relevant and objective selection criteria to shortlist and select job applicants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: There were only three cases in the last four years, out of a total of 2,100 cases of complaints on unfair employment practices examined by MOM and the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP).

sections.label: Institute of Human Resource Professionals
sections.summary: An Institute of Human Resource Professionals was set up to train HR practitioners so they put fair recruitment and employment practices in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: At the same time, we have also set up an Institute of Human Resource Professionals (IHRP) to encourage and provide a lot of training for HR practitioners and professionals, so that they will go back to their companies and put in place progressive and fair recruitment and employment practices.

sections.label: Three medicated condition discrimination cases
sections.summary: Three discrimination cases on medicated conditions were reported, and investigations found no evidence of actual discrimination, only miscommunication and misinformation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier, there have been three cases of discrimination reported on medicated conditions, and after our investigations and examination, we realised that, there is no evidence to suggest that there is actual discrimination on the ground.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: The complaints arose merely because of miscommunication and misinformation.
